content_md:
Looks like the lesser intelligence has to be able to at least speak the language of the higher intelligence to recognize its existence and make use of it.

So to confirm the existence of super intelligence we need a lesser intelligence within a certain delta difference.

I am guessing humans and AI have similar delta curve but one reaches for specialization and the other generalization.

We are able to one shot prompt AI long horizon bets by embedding most popular assumptions but those by definition fail outside the first standard deviation.
